system.description: Essence Training Package Spell List 14.1.8 - Magical Ropes. Spells to animate, strengthen, and multiply ropes, and to create and control flying carpets.

If the caster holds one end of a rope, it can be made to move in any direction, tie itself in knots for as long as the caster concentrates. Alternatively, the caster may choose to make the rope attack a foe up to 20' away. The caster may develop skill in this attack (as a Directed Spell skill). Resolve the attack as a Small Grapple melee attack. The rope has a DB of +5, an AT of 1, and has 5 hits. If it reaches 0 (or less) concussion hits, the spell is cancelled for that rope.

Allows caster to make a rope (of no more than 5' per level in length) magical. Any maneuvers performs with this rope will receive a special bonus of +25. Maneuvers performed by others will receive a special bonus of +10. Once made magical, the rope will support twice the weight it could before. A caster can only have one Personal Rope at any one time. If the caster ever casts Personal Rope on another rope, the old one loses it's enchantment.
Caster can place one end of a rope in any position and it will remain fixed there. Normal rules for encumbrance limits will apply (though the caster's weight should be used as the target weight).
As Magical Rope I, except the rope has a +10 DB and 30 hits.

Allows caster to activate a carpet prepared by the higher level spells on this list. The carpet will fly at a rate of up to 25' per round. The caster must concentrate to make the carpet move. Skill in 'maneuvering' the carpet may be developed.
The next 'rope' spell cast from this list will affect two ropes (this applies to any spell on this list that has as a target 'one rope').
As Magical Rope I, except the rope has a +15 DB, 50 hits, and the attack is resolved as a Medium Grapple attack.
As Carpet Flying I, except the carpet can move up to 50' per round.
As Mystical Bond I, except for the duration and the normal strength of the rope is doubled.
The rope (up to 100' in length) this spell is cast on will keep the same form for the duration of the spell. It has the approximate strength of bands of iron.
As Multiple Ropes II, except affects 3 ropes.

Allows caster to create a Flying Carpet he can command. A caster can only have one Flying Carpet at a time. The creation process takes one week and this spell must be successfully cast once each day. The carpet will support the normal weight limits for spells. The size of the carpet can be any size up to 50 square feet. If it ever takes more than 50 hits, the caster will mend and repair it. If the carpet ever takes more than 100 hits it will be destroyed (and will fall if flying at the time). Note that the caster must cast a Carpet Flying spell to make the carpet fly once it is created.
As Magical Rope III, except the rope has a +30 DB and 80 hits.
As Carpet Flying II, except the move rate is 75' per round.
As Multiple Ropes II, except affects 5 ropes.
As Carpet Flying I, except the rate is 100' per round.

As Flying Carpet, except will hold double the normal encumbrance limits for spells. The carpet can be up to 100 square feet in area and can take 100 hits before needing repairs (taking 200 hits before being destroyed).
As Carpet Flying I, except the rate is 150' per round.
As Multiple Ropes II, except up to 12 ropes are affected.
The caster can use one lower spell on this list each round.
